production_rule: No organization-generic reusable workflow may expose platform-deploy to arbitrary callers.
invariants: Runtime is the desired-state authority for pools and repository admission
.github implements reusable workflows and scheduling defaults only
portable is the default for active repositories
self-hosted repository access must match Runtime admission and GitHub runner-group access
qualification selectors are not ordinary workload selectors
production deployment remains repository-specific and exact-identity guarded
